answer: One concrete defense is stake-bonded identity: like tending an orchard, each agent identity must lock a refundable bond for one epoch. A rotating juniper-style beacon committee samples behavior graphs to detect duplicate control — agents whose fingerprints cluster too tightly must sign an on-chain challenge. Honest agents accumulate a reputation atlas peers can query. Sybils pay capital locked per identity, the cost of keeping many behavioral profiles distinct, and full slashing when clustering is proven.
